opening.argument: The presentation directly promotes a cryptocurrency-mining opportunity by instructing viewers to show others how to buy Bitcoin Cash and robots and to participate in webinars. It connects those purchases to recruitment and compensation: buying machines produces a direct bonus that is assigned to a binary structure to help another participant earn a commission. The speaker also asks how much viewers need to earn from cryptocurrency mining, presents becoming a millionaire within two or three years as an opportunity, and discusses possible returns of 2,000 to 4,000 Bitcoin Cash. Although the phrase “BIGGEST lie” may signal criticism of some statements, the presentation still gives direct promotional and recruitment instructions tied to purchases, investors, mining, and commissions. The qualifying language does not remove that solicitation or the promised wealth-oriented outcomes.
